We are looking to hire an experienced full-life cycle Recruiter to support the organization through its growth, predominantly within Sales with the opportunity to support other functions, like Marketing, Legal, and GBO. You'll be a driving force in building and executing the talent strategy, partnering with key stakeholders, and hiring top talent. This role will allow you to build positive relationships, exude our values, and contribute to our org-wide recruiting best practices and processes.

This is a foundational role in Brazil. In addition to execution on hiring, you will have the opportunity to support recruiting events, contribute to office expansion, and build strategic partnerships across the region.

This is a full time role that will be held in our Sao Paulo, Brazil hub.

· Manage full-cycle recruiting processes for our business organizations (specifically Sales)

· Partner with business leaders to develop top of funnel strategies for key roles

· Source and build healthy, representative pipelines to engage passive talent including: cold outreach, events, and content production while also effectively handling inbound applications and referrals

· Ability to build a talent strategy alongside your hiring managers, while delivering an exceptional candidate experience

· Excellent communication, in all formats and ability to adapt communication style based upon audience

· This role will focus on recruiting in Latin America, written and spoken fluency in Portuguese and English is required

We're excited to grow our Early Career team with a unique opportunity! Figma's AI and research strategy is a critical company priority, and attracting exceptional research talent is central to how we deliver on it.

We're looking for an experienced PhD Recruiter to own hiring strategy across Engineering and evolve our existing program into a scalable, year-round function. In this role, you'll lead end-to-end recruiting, shape hiring strategy with engineering leaders, and drive Figma's presence at top research conferences.

You'll be a trusted strategic partner with a genuine seat at the table, helping define how Figma competes for some of the most sought-after AI and research talent in the world.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

· Manage the full-cycle recruiting process for intern and full-time PhD roles across Engineering including but not limited to Data, AI, Graphics, and Security

· Partner with Eng VPs and Directors to own PhD hiring strategy, shaping how Figma approaches and scales research talent across the org

· Lead Figma's presence at research conferences like NeurIPS, aligning stakeholders and running on-site logistics from booth setup to interviewer prep

· Own the publication process for PhD roles, partnering with hiring teams, legal, and senior leadership

· Mentor recruiters on the team supporting PhD efforts, growing the bench as the function scales

· Lead the strategic direction of the PhD recruiting function, building processes from scratch and closing offers with a rare, highly sought-after pool of research talent

s.h: We'd love to hear from you if you have
s.t:
· 6+ years of full-lifecycle technical recruiting experience in a high-growth organization, including 3+ years focused on PhD/research hiring

· A track record of hiring PhD candidates through self-sourced pipelines, including conferences, research labs, and professor connections

· Experience building and running PhD programs

· Demonstrated success partnering with senior engineering leaders and executives on high-priority, high-touch candidate and offer scenarios

· Willingness to travel internationally to conferences, universities, and labs, roughly 3-4 trips per year

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Join our world-class Global Foundation Recruiting team, renowned for its dedication to excellence and innovation in talent acquisition. We are a dynamic, fun and passionate group, committed to building a diverse and high-performing workforce that propels our mission forward. As we navigate the ever-evolving landscape of our business, we pride ourselves on our collaborative approach, working closely with leaders across EMEA to shape their hiring strategies.

Our team is focused on attracting the best talent of this generation, ensuring that we not only meet our strategic goals but also foster an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive, have fun and support each other. Together, we are setting the standard for recruiting excellence at Airbnb.

Your main responsibility will be to successfully bring searches to fruition and deliver exceptional experiences for candidates and hiring managers. Our team takes a consultative approach, working closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions. Dedicated to sourcing and hiring top talent in the market, we ensure that every individual interacting with Airbnb’s recruitment process feels valued and supported.

· Manage and drive a full-cycle recruitment process including sourcing, screening, interview, feedback and offers for all levels of candidates from entry to senior level.

· Build pipeline for multiple requisitions across business teams and geographies, consider diversity and the importance of balanced candidate slates.

· Drive inclusion through building diverse pipelines at top of the funnel.

· Partner with talent partners, hiring managers, HR operations and finance to build hiring strategy and plan.

· Influence business leaders and educate hiring managers on process, interview best practices, and decision making.

· Provide exceptional candidate experiences. Create new ways to surprise and delight candidates as they go through our interview process.

· Accurately track candidate data and use systems correctly to be able to report to the business.

· Find the best, brightest and most passionate people for Airbnb using new and creative ways to find and engage them.

· Represent Airbnb with integrity and professionalism. Speak passionately and authentically about Airbnb and our mission.

· 5 - 7+ years full cycle recruiting experience is required.

· Experience recruiting in high volume, general & administrative functions is a plus.

· Track record for successfully identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional candidates.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to communicate complex concepts concisely and clearly.

· Well-developed analytical and influencing skills.

· Demonstrates a positive, can do attitude. Receives feedback well and looks to constantly improve and grow.

· Comfortable working with a high degree of ambiguity.

· Ability to be patient and communicate respectfully in a fast paced environment.

· Strong organizational and planning skills and a solutions orientation.

· Genuine curiosity and strong desire to continuously learn and grow.

· High-level of self-initiative, creativity, perseverance, and flexibility.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The recruiting team seeks to build the culture of Stripe by aligning the strongest global talent to our highest impact business needs. They focus on bringing Stripe’s operating principles to life in their recruiting processes, providing the highest-quality candidate experience, and leveraging data driven storytelling to influence the business.

To further this important mission, we are looking for consultative and creative recruiters to grow and scale our Go-to-Market (GTM) team. The GTM organization at Stripe encompasses our Sales team, Marketing and Sales Development, GTM and Product Operations, and Professional Services.

These teams are expanding in the region, focusing on bringing new users onto the Stripe platform, supporting our existing users' scale, and growing their businesses. You can expect high impact and wide-ranging responsibilities: owning full-cycle recruiting, driving hiring strategy, and delivering best-in-class candidate experience.

This person must be a builder who thrives in a learning environment—unafraid to try new things, embrace new ideas, and welcome suggestions for how we can iterate on our processes.

· Develop and execute strategic sourcing plans to identify and engage top talent, ensuring a robust and inclusive candidate pool for current and future hiring needs

· Conduct regular market research and analysis to stay informed about talent trends, using insights to inform recruiting strategies and address potential challenges

· Partner with senior leaders across the organization to understand their hiring objectives and develop recruiting strategies aimed at achieving headcount goals, with an emphasis on expanding our GTM teams across the US, LatAM and Canada

· Track and analyze recruiting metrics, providing regular reports on hiring progress to business leadership to ensure transparency and alignment with goals

· Propose and implement creative and scalable changes to the existing recruiting strategy to enhance efficacy and reach

· Work closely with cross-functional teams—including Finance, People Ops, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal—to deliver a seamless and high-quality candidate experience

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

· 4+ years of full-cycle Recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment including in house experience

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills

· Strong ability to build relationships with senior leaders and effectively influence decision-making processes

· Strong drive to identify and engage top talent, fostering relationships with candidates

· Proven ability to utilize data insights to identify trends and refine recruiting processes, enhancing efficiency and outcomes

· Flexibility, adept at shifting tasks and priorities in response to changing circumstances

· Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), such as Greenhouse, Lever, or similar platforms

· Experience leveraging sourcing and CRM tools (e.g., Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter) to build and manage talent pipelines

· Strong working knowledge of recruiting analytics and reporting tools to drive data-informed hiring strategies

· Familiarity with scheduling, communication, and collaboration tools (e.g., GoodTime, Slack, G Suite)

· Ability to quickly adopt new recruiting technologies and optimize workflows for scale

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

At Ramp, people are the single biggest lever on our trajectory, and the bar for who joins this team gets higher every quarter, not lower. We're hiring a Recruiter who treats recruiting as a research discipline as much as a relationship one: someone who can map a market, identify the operators who'll outperform their peers, and run a full-cycle process that wins them.
You'll own end-to-end hiring across Sales and GTM functions, from first conversation through offer close, and partner with GTM leadership to translate ambitious hiring plans into real teams. The recruiters who do this best at Ramp combine craft on the front end (research, identification, calibration) with execution on the back end (closing, candidate experience, pipeline discipline). We're looking for both.

Use AI and research to find top talent. You'll build target lists of high performers at peer and aspirational companies using LinkedIn Recruiter, Sales Navigator, Gong signals, internal data, and AI tools like Claude. We expect AI to be part of your daily workflow, not a novelty, but a core part of how you identify, qualify, and reach candidates.
Calibrate quickly and map the market. For every new search, you'll develop a clear point of view on what "great" looks like, who fits the profile, and where to find them, then share that POV with hiring managers as a written artifact rather than just a slate of resumes.
Run thoughtful, personalized outreach. The best replies come from outbound that's grounded in real research, a candidate's territory, deal motion, or recent move. We care more about reply rate and onsite conversion than send volume.
Own the full cycle, from first outreach through offer close, including pipeline hygiene in Ashby, stakeholder updates, and offer construction.
Close candidates with competing offers. Many of our strongest GTM hires are weighing multiple options, and you'll partner with hiring managers and leadership to build conviction, sequence references, and run a closing motion that wins on substance.
Be a strategic partner to GTM leaders. Push back when a search is mis-scoped, surface compensation reality early, and translate hiring-manager wishlists into a concrete profile within days.
Deliver an excellent candidate experience that's fair, transparent, and fast. Feedback is honest; offers move in days, not weeks.
Improve how we hire by contributing to process changes, comp benchmarking, employer brand, and how Ramp evaluates GTM talent.
What You Need
5+ years of full-cycle GTM/Sales recruiting, ideally in a high-growth or top-tier startup environment where the bar was non-negotiable.
A real track record of identifying strong talent, not just running searches that closed. Bring examples of candidates you found, ran a process for, and who became top performers.
Comfort using AI in your day-to-day workflow. You already use LLMs to research candidates, draft personalized outreach, summarize calls, or surface signals from messy data, or you're eager to. We see AI fluency as core to how recruiting works going forward.
Research instincts. You can articulate why a given candidate is in the top decile of their cohort, not just that they have the right title at the right company.
Closing skill. You've personally closed senior hires against competing offers from top-tier companies.
Data literacy. You're comfortable in Ashby (or equivalent ATS) and with funnel metrics, and willing to challenge a hiring manager with the numbers when needed.
High urgency operating mode. You book next steps on the call, not after, and you own the candidate's experience through to signature.
Excellent written communication. Your outbound and your candidate updates are the work product, and they should be specific, sharp, and not template-driven.
Intellectually curious, high integrity, allergic to mediocrity.
Nice-to-Have
Direct experience recruiting AEs, Sales Managers, RevOps, or Sales Leadership at a high-growth fintech, SaaS, or infra company.
Experience building or contributing to an AI-augmented research workflow.
Comfort with Snowflake or SQL, or willingness to learn. Ramp's pipeline data lives there and the best recruiters here read it directly.
Familiarity with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Sales Navigator, and Gong.

Meet and greet candidates while they are onsite for interviews

Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.
Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.
Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

Effectively identify, attract, and engage top Software Engineering candidates through creative sourcing strategies and talent mapping.
Source and maintain a large, high-quality pipeline across high-priority Software Engineer roles, balancing volume and specialization.
Partner with Zip’s founders, Head of Engineering, and senior leadership to define hiring needs, ideal candidate profiles, and go-to-market recruiting strategies.
Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers by providing market insights, competitive intelligence, and data-driven recommendations.
Screen, vet, and guide candidates throughout the interview and hiring process while keeping candidate experience top of mind.
Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and People teams to drive alignment and land successful hires.
Lead compensation conversations and offer negotiations, including startup equity packages.
Track recruiting metrics and performance to continuously optimize processes, improve conversion rates, and scale hiring effectively.
Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and senior leadership to influence decision-making and hiring outcomes.

3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a focus on Software Engineering roles (backend, frontend & full-stack)
Proven success hiring for other Engineering roles such as Data Engineering, Security Engineering, Machine Learning, Infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, and AI Engineers.
Ability to influence and build trusted relationships with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to represent Zip’s story and value prop to top talent.
A strong sense of ownership and passion for delivering excellent results with speed and precision.
Highly proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented, thriving in ambiguity and a fast-moving startup environment.
Detail-oriented and organized, comfortable managing multiple requisitions and competing priorities simultaneously.
Strong experience working with ATS platforms; Ashby experience preferred.
Familiarity with compensation structures and negotiating startup equity packages.

Experience scaling recruiting in a high-growth startup.
Background in B2B SaaS and/or Fintech recruiting.
Previous experience managing both volume hiring and niche, senior-level searches.
Experience building recruiting processes from the ground up and thriving in ambiguity.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.

Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across +200 specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power.

In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

We’re looking for a Technical Recruiter to join our truly global Talent team at ElevenLabs. This is not a conventional recruiter role — you’ll own complex, high-impact technical hiring end to end, from shaping the search strategy through to closing truly exceptional talent. You’ll partner deeply with engineering, research, and leadership teams to re-imagine what great technical hiring looks like at scale.
You’ll be a key member of a small, high-powered team that’s redefining quality of hire and pushing the boundaries of how world-class technical talent is found, engaged, and hired. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical specialization, high velocity, and an uncompromising bar .
If you’re energized by ownership, creative problem-solving, and building hiring systems that scale — this role will stretch and level up your career.

s.h: What your day might look like
s.t:
Owning full-cycle recruiting for highly technical roles across product engineering, ML/AI, infrastructure, research, and beyond.
Partnering closely with hiring managers to deeply understand problems, calibrate on signals, and continuously raise the hiring bar.
Designing and executing thoughtful search strategies — from market mapping and outreach to interview design and closing.
Managing multiple complex searches simultaneously without sacrificing candidate experience or quality.
Acting as a trusted advisor to candidates, guiding them through a rigorous process with clarity, empathy, and conviction.
Serving as an ambassador for ElevenLabs — every interaction reflects our values and sets the tone for the candidate experience.
Continuously improving how we hire by iterating on processes, tooling, and data-driven insights.

Proven experience hiring top-tier engineering and technical talent in competitive markets (we’d love to see ~3+ years, but impact matters more than years).
Experience running full-cycle technical recruiting, including sourcing strategy, stakeholder management, and closing.
Strong ability to manage high-complexity searches with many moving parts — you stay structured, adaptable, and focused.
Skilled at translating technical and business needs into clear hiring strategies and compelling candidate narratives.
Excellent written and verbal communication — you build trust with both deeply technical candidates and senior stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, remote-first environments and collaborating across global time zones.
Curious, creative, and genuinely interested in engineering, AI, and how exceptional teams are built.

Experience hiring for research, infrastructure, systems, or other deeply technical roles.
Experience recruiting globally across multiple regions.
Background in high-growth startups or similarly fast-moving environments.
A builder’s mindset: you experiment, learn quickly, spot patterns, and continuously refine recruiting playbooks and processes.
Location
This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

About Decagon
Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.
Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.
We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.
We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.
Every great talent team starts with exceptional hiring. As a Recruiting Coordinator on our GTM Recruiting team, you’ll play a critical role in helping Decagon build a world class GTM team.

You’ll partner closely with recruiters, go to market leaders, and interviewers to orchestrate a seamless hiring experience for some of the world’s top GTM talent. From coordinating complex interview loops to helping us continuously improve our recruiting operations, you’ll be at the center of one of the company’s most important functions.
This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how world-class GTM recruiting operates inside one of the fastest-growing AI companies. You’ll work alongside experienced recruiters, revenue leaders, gain exposure to the full hiring lifecycle, and build a strong foundation for a long-term career in Talent.
In this role, you will
Own end-to-end interview coordination and scheduling with precision and care, managing complex, high-volume calendars across candidates, interviewers, and leadership.
Champion a white-glove candidate experience from first touch to close.
Build trust through clear, proactive communication with candidates, interviewers, hiring teams, and cross-functional partners across People/HR, EA team, Workplace, and Finance.
Partner closely with recruiting and hiring stakeholders to proactively solve scheduling challenges and keep hiring momentum high.
Maintain exceptional attention to detail across scheduling systems and recruiting tools, ensuring information is accurate and processes are executed flawlessly.
Track scheduling timelines and SLAs, surfacing trends and risks to recruiters and hiring managers to keep stakeholders informed.
Help elevate the team's coordination practices by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, leverage AI and improve the candidate experience at scale.

Bachelor’s degree in any field.
Experience in a fast-paced, high-performing environment.
Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and solving problems proactively.
Dependable, resourceful, and known for following through on commitments.
Excited to build a career in go to market recruiting.

Experience with Ashby or another applicant tracking system (ATS).
Experience coordinating recruiting or supporting go to market teams.
Experience using AI tools to streamline workflows or improve operational efficiency.

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations.

Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide.

Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

As a Recruiter at Sardine, you will play a critical role in scaling our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization within the EMEA region during a period of rapid growth.

Reporting directly to the Talent Lead for Business, you’ll be responsible for building strong talent pipelines, delivering an exceptional candidate experience, and continuously improving recruiting processes as we scale. As part of a fast-moving, remote-first organization, you’ll thrive in an environment that values ownership and collaboration.

Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for GTM roles, including sales, business development, sales engineering, integrations, accounts management, partnership, and more, across multiple regions in EMEA, MENA, and APAC
Own the full candidate journey from first touch to close, sourcing proactively across job boards, applicants, outbound outreach, social media, and your network
Partner with hiring managers to define job requirements, create job descriptions, and develop a clear hiring strategy for each role
Act as a trusted partner to hiring teams by providing market insight and mapping, funnel recommendations, and calibration support throughout the search
Own the candidate experience from first outreach through offer close - every candidate, regardless of outcome, should leave the process feeling respected and well-informed

5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruitment, with at least 3+ years in a high-growth tech startup environment
Proven experience recruiting for GTM (sales, post-sales, marketing, partnership) roles in a B2B SaaS company

About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline.

At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores.

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

As a Senior Technical Recruiter at Faire, you will play a critical role in scaling our fast-growing Data, Machine Learning, and Engineering teams. We are looking for someone who operates as a true talent advisor, deeply embedded with senior leadership, shaping how we hire for our most complex and high-stakes technical roles.

You will be responsible for setting recruiting strategy across Data and Engineering, driving excellence in process and candidate experience, and serving as a force multiplier for the broader recruiting team. This is a senior individual contributor role with potential for direct reports for someone who is ready to own the most critical searches on the team while helping define what great technical recruiting looks like at Faire.

This is a high-impact role based in San Francisco with significant scope to influence recruiting strategy as the business evolves.

· Lead full-cycle recruiting for the most complex and senior Data, ML, and Engineering roles, including Staff and Principal levels from role scoping through close.

· Serve as a strategic talent partner to key stakeholders, shaping role requirements, calibrating on market dynamics, and driving rigorous, data-informed hiring processes.

· Own and evolve sourcing strategy across Data and Engineering, building differentiated approaches through outbound campaigns, networks, events, and community partnerships to engage top-tier technical talent.

· Champion candidate experience at the highest level, ensuring Faire's process is transparent, efficient, and compelling from first touchpoint to offer acceptance.

· Lead complex offer negotiations end-to-end, providing expert guidance on competitive compensation, equity positioning, and closing strategies for senior technical hires.

· Maintain high data integrity within Greenhouse and produce sophisticated pipeline reporting and hiring insights that directly influence leadership decision-making.

· Act as a senior resource across the recruiting team, elevating best practices, sponsoring process improvements, and helping shape how Faire approaches technical recruiting at scale.

· Champion Faire's values and DEI commitment, ensuring inclusive pipelines and equitable hiring practices across all searches.

· 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with at least 3 years focused on senior technical hiring across data and/or engineering disciplines (machine learning, data science, software engineering, or related fields).

· Demonstrated ability to close Staff+ and leadership-level technical candidates in highly competitive markets.

· Experience operating as a strategic partner to senior engineering or data leadership, with the credibility and business acumen to influence at the executive level.

· Experience recruiting in fast-paced, high-growth environments (startup or scaling tech strongly preferred).

· Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage a complex portfolio of searches, stakeholders, and pipelines simultaneously.

· Data-driven mindset with a track record of using pipeline and hiring insights to drive strategic decisions.

· Exceptional communication and influencing skills, able to navigate ambiguity, build trust quickly, and drive alignment across competing priorities.

· Passionate about candidate experience, employer branding, and building inclusive, high-performing teams.

San Francisco, CA: the pay range for this role is $148,000 to $203,500 per year.

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

· Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.

· Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.

Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.

At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love.

Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.

Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!

This role operates on a hybrid schedule requiring two days of in-office collaboration per week every Tuesday & Wednesday.

We’re hiring a Lead Recruiter to run our hardest searches across Taskrabbit, from senior engineers to executives. You’ll report to the Head of Talent Acquisition as a senior individual contributor, own your roles end-to-end, and help shape how we hire as a company.You’re a full-cycle recruiter who’s spent most of your career hiring technical talent.

You make decisions with data, use AI to do more with less, and can run any search across function or level without much hand-holding. Marketplace or consumer tech experience is a plus.

· Run end-to-end searches across every function and level, including our hardest engineering, product, and executive roles.

· Partner with senior leaders to build hiring plans, calibrate roles, and shape offers.

· Use AI to automate sourcing, outreach, screening, and scheduling so we move faster without losing quality.

· Track funnel and source data in Greenhouse and use it to coach hiring managers and inform leadership decisions.

· Build diverse pipelines of senior technical talent, with a strong focus on passive candidates in the Bay Area.

· Work alongside our Senior Recruiter and the rest of Talent to sharpen our playbooks, interviews, and candidate experience.

· Represent Taskrabbit in every candidate conversation. Candidates remember who you are.

· 10+ years of full-cycle recruiting, with 5+ focused on technical hiring (engineering, ML/AI, data, product).

· Comfortable running searches solo across any function or level, IC through executive.

· Hands-on with AI tools for sourcing, outreach, screening, or scheduling, with results to show for it (Bonus if you can share automated workflows)

· Fluent in recruiting data. Builds dashboards, defines KPIs, and uses numbers to influence decisions.

· Expert in Greenhouse or similar ATS (reporting, scorecards, workflows) and fluent with LinkedIn Recruiter.

· Knows the San Francisco tech market. Marketplace or consumer tech background is a plus.

· Strong executive presence. Can push back on senior leaders when the data calls for it.

At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + benefits + perks. The base pay range for this position is $130,000 - $150,000.

This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.

· Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company. We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.

· The People. You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!

· The Diverse Culture. We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.

· The Perks. Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

We are seeking a Recruiter to help us find passionate, talented, and qualified individuals to join the Charlie Health team. The Recruiter maintains corporate candidate pipelines while working to develop new ones. They ensure job seekers across the country know about Charlie Health by building our presence across job sites, professional organizations, and other channels. They also proactively identify and perform outreach to qualified people, inspiring them to consider a career at Charlie Health.

Our team is comprised of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing life-saving solutions. We are looking for a candidate who is inspired by our mission and excited by the opportunity to build a business that will impact millions of lives in a profound way.

Note - we are looking to hire multiple recruiters across different business groups including admissions, engineering, and operations.

· Create talent acquisition strategy for respective hiring managers including needs analysis; provide guidance to hiring managers related to talent acquisition process

· Source qualified candidates through a wide variety of channels and manage the end to end talent acquisition process

· Evaluate, interview and present qualified candidates to hiring managers and solicit feedback on candidates to refine talent acquisition strategy as applicable

· Organize marketing campaigns on job boards, industry websites, and other applicant-facing channels

· Maintain relationships with external recruiting partners and manage candidate pipeline in an organization fashion

· Develop relationships with key networks to broaden the applicant pool

· Meet with interested candidates to introduce them to the Charlie Health model and mission

· Be creative—identify new ways to bring candidates to their next roles at Charlie Health!

· At least 2-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in a high growth startup or large organization sourcing for corporate roles

· Full-cycle recruiting experience required - ability to source candidates, manage interview process and conduct offer negotiations through close

· Strong interpersonal, relationship-building and listening skills, with a natural, consultative style

· Ability to energize, communicate, and build rapport internally and externally

· Strong project management skills, with a demonstrable ability to corral and manage details in a fast-paced, fluid environment

· Work authorized in the United States and native or bilingual English proficiency

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here .

The Opportunity

The Recruiting Operations Coordinator is the operational backbone of Postman's recruiting function. In this role, you will ensure that every search runs smoothly from open to close — keeping interviews scheduled, data clean, feedback flowing, and candidates well-informed throughout their experience.

This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who is organized, detail-oriented, and excited to build foundational expertise in talent acquisition at a fast-growing technology company. You will work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates, and will play a direct role in how Postman is perceived as an employer.

Interview Coordination

· Own end-to-end interview scheduling across all active roles, coordinating availability between candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers with a high degree of accuracy and responsiveness

· Send timely confirmations, reminders, and logistical details to all interview participants

· Manage reschedules and last-minute changes with professionalism and minimal disruption to the process

· Proactively identify and solve scheduling or process bottlenecks, continuously improving recruiting workflows and coordination processes

Data Integrity & ATS Hygiene

· Audit active job requisitions to ensure all required fields are complete and accurate in the ATS — including job details, compensation bands, stage statuses, and interviewer assignments

· Flag and resolve data gaps in collaboration with recruiters before they affect reporting

· Ensure every closed role has a complete and accurate record before it is archived

Feedback & Interview Completion

· Monitor interview completion rates and follow up with interviewers to ensure feedback is submitted within expected SLAs

· Track which interviews have been recorded and flag any gaps to the relevant recruiter

· Maintain a real-time view of where feedback is outstanding across all active searches

Candidate Experience & Surveys

· Deliver a high-touch, candidate-first experience across every stage of the interview process

· Coordinate the distribution of candidate experience surveys at key touchpoints in the process

· Track response rates and flag low engagement to the recruiting team

· Compile survey results on a regular cadence and summarize key themes for review

Employer Brand Monitoring

· Monitor Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Blind, and other relevant platforms for new candidate and employee reviews related to the recruiting and interview experience

· Surface notable feedback to the recruiting team on a regular basis

· Help maintain the accuracy of Postman's employer profiles across platforms

Metrics & Reporting

· Collect and organize data on completed roles, including time to fill, source, offer acceptance, and interview-to-offer ratios

· Prepare regular metric summaries for the Head of Recruiting

· Support the team in ensuring data is ready and accurate for monthly and quarterly reporting cycles

You are someone who takes genuine pride in keeping things running well. You notice when something is missing before anyone else does, and you follow through without needing to be reminded. You are comfortable working across multiple workstreams simultaneously and can shift priorities calmly when something urgent comes up.

· Comfort with tools like Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and calendar management; experience with an ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday) is a bonus

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Job Purpose

You will join a smart, collaborative, and passionate team of recruiters who take pride in the craft of finding and keeping great talent. As a Technical Recruiter, you act as the bridge between Moniepoint’s innovative engineering goals and the people who build them.

You will partner directly with engineering leaders to own the end-to-end recruitment journey. The ideal candidate is someone who doesn't just "fill roles" but understands the technology and cares deeply about the human experience behind every application

· Full-Cycle Ownership: Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for technical roles, from initial job intake and sourcing to interviewing, offer negotiation, and successful onboarding.

· Strategic Sourcing: Design and execute proactive sourcing strategies to build diverse pipelines for current and future engineering needs.

· Stakeholder Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, helping them define technical requirements and providing data-driven insights on the talent market.

· Candidate Advocacy: Ensure every candidate has a clear, respectful, and high-quality experience, regardless of the outcome.

· Process Innovation: Identify ways to improve hiring workflows, from better screening techniques to more efficient interviewing panels.

· Brand Ambassadorship: Represent Moniepoint in the tech community, sharing the mission to create financial happiness through technology.

· 5-7 years of experience in recruitment, with at least 3 years focused specifically on technical roles (Engineering, Product, Data).

· Proven track record of hiring in fast-paced tech environments or high-growth scale-ups.

· Deep experience in full-life-cycle recruitment, including complex offer negotiations and stakeholder management.

· Experience with both agency and in-house recruitment is preferred.

· Hands-on experience with modern Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and sourcing tools.

· Experience hiring across multiple geographies (e.g., Nigeria, UK, India).

· Background in fintech or banking environments.

· Familiarity with technical assessment platforms and competency-based interviewing.

· You're a Creator: You don't wait for the right candidate to apply; you find imaginative ways to source and engage talent that others might miss.

· You're Relatable: You speak the language of engineers and candidates alike; you are human, friendly, and avoid jargon that excludes people.

· You're a Hero for the Business: You take ownership and, when a hiring goal is tough, you lean in with grit and mastery to solve it.

· You value clarity: You are honest with candidates and hiring managers, setting clear expectations and sticking to the facts.

· Systems Thinker: You see how a single hire impacts the wider team and build processes that scale.

What Success Looks Like

· Impactful Hires: Engineering teams are staffed with high-performing talent who align with the culture and mission.

· Efficiency: Key metrics like time-to-hire and quality-of-hire are tracked and improved through smarter processes.

· Candidate Sentiment: Candidates report a positive and transparent experience, measured through recruitment surveys.

· Strong Partnerships: Hiring managers view you as a strategic partner, not just a service provider.

What to expect in the hiring process

· A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters.

· A case study + panel interview with the Talent Acquisition Leadership Team.

· An interview with the Global Head of Talent Acquisition.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company delivering responsive launch services, complete spacecraft design and manufacturing, payloads, satellite components, and more – all with the goal of opening access to space. The rockets and satellites we build and launch enable some of the most ambitious and vital space missions globally, supporting scientific exploration, Earth observation and missions to combat climate change, national security, and exciting new technology demonstrations.

Our Electron rocket has become the second most frequently launched U.S. rocket annually and has delivered more than 230 satellites to orbit, all while we work to develop Neutron, our upcoming medium-lift, reusable launch vehicle for larger constellation deployment.

Our Space Systems business designs and builds our extensive line of satellites, payloads, and their components, including spacecraft that have been selected to support NASA missions to the Moon and Mars and components used on the James Webb Space Telescope.

Rocket Lab’s People & Culture team is responsible for looking after our most valuable asset: our people. Across our global teams, the People & Culture team supports our people and departments across recruitment, new staff orientation, compensation, training and development.

They make sure our growing and diverse global team is supported and capable of delivering our projects and customer’s missions, and they’re responsible for supporting their development, nurturing their skills and talent, and retaining the world-class people already on our team.

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.
By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.
What you'll be doing
As our Talent Acquisition Partner, you'll play a key role in building Satispay's most complex and critical functions — Governance, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and HR — as well as owning executive-level hiring. You won't just fill vacancies: you'll think ahead, map markets, and bring in talent that is genuinely hard to find.

s.h: Here's what your day-to-day will look like
s.t:
Own end-to-end recruiting for complex roles – design and execute hiring strategies for Governance, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and HR roles, including apical roles, fully autonomously.
Master passive candidate sourcing – identify and engage hard-to-find talent across multiple channels; build relationships with candidates before roles open, not just when you have a live vacancy.
Lead offer management – own the full offer process — from strategy definition with the hiring manager, through negotiation, to signed offer — managing compensation discussions and competing offer situations confidently.
Drive Hiring Manager partnerships – proactively own the relationship with each hiring manager; keep them informed on pipeline status and recruiting strategy through data, not just updates.
Champion candidate experience – use pipeline data and candidate feedback to identify gaps and propose concrete improvements to the candidate journey.
Manage external partners – build and maintain a network of executive search firms, specialist agencies, and external recruiters; know when to activate them and how to get the best out of the collaboration.
Contribute to team strategy and projects – participate in cross-functional projects inside and outside the TA team; take ownership of smaller team initiatives and contribute meaningfully to larger ones.
Represent Satispay externally – act as a Satispay ambassador at external events, conferences, and in the talent market — independently and with confidence.

We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in!

3–7 years of full-cycle recruiting experience – in-house or agency, with a track record of closing complex, niche, or senior roles.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team

The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity.

We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and talent development practices. .Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda.

Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.

The Opportunity

Help build the teams powering Agoda’s global partner network

Agoda is a digital travel platform that helps people experience the world for less. Our Supply organization builds and strengthens Agoda’s global network of accommodation and travel partners, supporting areas such as partner operations, account management, business development, commercial strategy, and market growth.

As an Associate Talent Acquisition Partner supporting Supply, you will manage recruitment for assigned roles and help attract the talent that enables Agoda to grow its partner network and deliver value to partners and travelers worldwide.

You will work closely with candidates, Hiring Managers, recruiters, coordinators, and People Team partners to deliver high-quality hiring outcomes—efficiently, fairly, and with care.

· Manage assigned recruitment processes end to end, from intake through offer and pre-onboarding.

· Partner with Supply Hiring Managers to understand hiring needs, provide pipeline updates, and keep recruitment moving.

· Deliver against agreed hiring targets, SLAs, timelines, and quality expectations.

· Create a clear, professional, and engaging experience for every candidate.

· Monitor pipeline health, funnel conversion, candidate freshness, Time in Stage, and offer acceptance.

· Use data to identify risks and recommend practical actions to improve hiring outcomes.

· Identify and escalate challenges such as low pipeline quality, candidate drop-off, delayed feedback, or interviewer availability.

· Maintain accurate recruitment records and follow Agoda’s hiring policies, scorecard standards, and compliance requirements.

· Collaborate with Recruitment Operations, Coordination, Offers, Onboarding, Global Mobility, Compensation and Benefits, HRBP, and other People Team partners.

· Contribute to sourcing activities, recruitment events, referrals, team initiatives, and process improvements.

· Actively seek feedback and build expertise in sourcing, screening, structured interviewing, stakeholder management, candidate experience, and recruitment analytics.

s.t:
· Takes ownership and keeps recruitment moving without constant follow-up.

· Understands the business context behind the roles they support.

· Anticipates risks and acts before they affect the hiring outcome.

· Uses data to understand pipeline performance and guide actions.

· Communicates clearly, directly, and respectfully with candidates and stakeholders.

· Makes sound decisions and knows when to escalate.

· Protects fairness, confidentiality, compliance, and candidate experience.

· Learns quickly, responds well to feedback, and demonstrates visible growth.

· Builds credibility through reliability, preparation, and follow-through.

· Experience or demonstrated interest in Talent Acquisition, recruitment, HR, staffing, or a related field.

· Strong organization, prioritization, communication, and follow-through.

· Ability to manage multiple roles, deadlines, and stakeholders.

· Comfort using data, dashboards, spreadsheets, or recruitment systems.

· Strong attention to detail and sound judgment with confidential information.

· Curiosity, resilience, ownership, and willingness to learn.

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international environment.

· Experience managing requisitions or end-to-end recruitment processes.

· Experience hiring for commercial, account management, business development, partner management, or operations roles.

· Experience with an Applicant Tracking System.

· Familiarity with recruitment metrics such as Time to Hire, Time to Fill, Offer Acceptance, Interview 1 to Hire, Time in Stage, and Candidate Freshness.

· Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription.

We're looking for a passionate and driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our People team in Spain! This is a fully remote role, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere in the country. Please note that candidates must currently reside in Spain.
Join us at an exciting stage of growth at Wellhub, where you'll play a key role in shaping our European expansion. As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will partner closely with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to attract, engage, and hire top talent across the region.
In this role, you'll translate business needs into effective hiring strategies, helping to build high-performing teams that drive success in both established and new markets. You'll take ownership of end-to-end recruitment processes, ensuring an outstanding candidate experience while maintaining speed and quality.
Beyond day-to-day hiring, you'll contribute to improving recruiting practices through data-driven insights, helping us scale efficiently as we continue to grow. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys a mix of hands-on recruiting and strategic impact, and who is excited to help shape the future of our teams across Europe.

Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for non-technical roles up to G7 level, ensuring high-quality hires and alignment with business needs.
Partner closely with Hiring Managers and People Business Partners to define hiring strategies, evaluation criteria, and ensure a seamless calibration through kickoff meetings.
Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to build diverse talent pipelines and improve overall hiring effectiveness.
Drive a positive candidate experience by maintaining transparent communication, providing timely feedback, and acting as a professional brand ambassador for Wellhub.
Analyze recruitment metrics and data to identify bottlenecks, optimize processes, and formally propose improvements to increase the TA function's efficiency.
Ensure compliance with global labor laws, internal SLAs, and data accuracy (cost centers, candidate stages, and budget alignment) within our ATS (Greenhouse).
Promote diversity, equity, and belonging by proactively sourcing from underrepresented groups and mitigating biases throughout the selection process.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (People Ops, OD&B) to ensure smooth onboarding and contribute to employer branding initiatives.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field.
Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment, with a focus on high-demand environments.
Strong analytical skills to track, interpret, and report recruitment metrics.

Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), preferably Greenhouse, to manage candidate pipelines.
Solid knowledge of sourcing strategies and tools to attract diverse talent.

You will join selectry as a Senior Recruiter and run end-to-end searches through our Hiring Engine for our clients. You own the process from structured intake to signed offer, use data to improve it, and build the sourcing infrastructure that makes the next search faster than the one before.
Why this role exists
selectry is a Berlin-based hr-tech company. We build and operate the Hiring Engine for plannable recruiting. Our three product lines cover different levels of recruiting ownership for our clients. What they share is a common requirement: searches need to be run well, documented clearly, and improved continuously.
We are a small, senior team. Decisions move quickly. The work is concrete. We run our own searches and source proactively rather than relying on inbound volume. We source, assess, and advise, and we document every step.
This role exists because the Hiring Engine needs an experienced recruiter who can carry searches independently, consult clients and hiring managers with evidence and clarity, and help build the sourcing and process infrastructure that makes selectry's output reliable and repeatable.
What you will work on
Own the full recruiting lifecycle across client searches, from intake and role clarification through active sourcing, structured assessment, and offer management to signed contract
Design and run multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, XING, and direct outreach, including complex Boolean search and talent mapping for specialist and leadership profiles
Build and maintain talent pools of passive candidates across the segments selectry searches most frequently, structured, auditable, and ready for the next search
Conduct structured, competency-based interviews and advise hiring managers on evaluation criteria, profile fit, and decision quality
Track, analyse, and report on recruiting KPIs, including time-to-hire, time-to-fill, funnel conversion, and source-of-hire, and use the data to improve the process at every stage
Create and maintain search briefs, outreach templates, and interview guides within selectry's documentation infrastructure
Lead employer branding projects for selectry itself, for example career page content, candidate experience improvements, and outreach standards
Must-haves
Strong experience in recruiting, with end-to-end ownership of complex, specialist, or leadership hiring processes from sourcing through to offer
Hands-on active sourcing experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and multi-channel direct outreach, including the ability to design Boolean search strategies and talent maps independently
Experience building and maintaining structured talent pools for passive candidate segments using a CRM or ATS
Experience conducting competency-based candidate interviews and advising hiring managers on evaluation frameworks and profile decisions
KPI literacy: you have tracked recruiting data and used it to change a process, with a concrete example you can explain
German at C2 level and English at minimum C1, both required from day one, as searches run in both languages
Reliable self-management in a remote setup, careful documentation, and clear written communication
Nice-to-haves
Background in sales recruiting, executive search, or specialist/leadership hiring in a B2B or technology environment
Delivered employer branding work with concrete outputs, for example employer value proposition (EVP) development, career page content, candidate experience design, or career fair coordination
Familiarity with mid-market ATS or CRM-based recruiting platforms, for example Personio, Greenhouse, or Recruitee
Familiarity with the DACH talent market and its sourcing dynamics, particularly for niche or hard-to-fill profiles
How we work
selectry is fully remote within Germany, with our registered office in Berlin. The team is deliberately small so decisions are made quickly and work stays concrete. We use documented playbooks, clean process logic, and a tooling setup.
Technology supports the work. Humans verify and decide. That applies to how we run our product and to how we work internally.
There are no vanity metrics here. A good search is one where the right person was found, the process was fair, and the documentation lets us learn from it.
Working conditions
Location: 100% remote (DE), registered office in Berlin
Work model: Full-time, flexible hours with agreed collaboration windows
Contract: Permanent employment
Languages: German C2 (mandatory), English min. C1 (mandatory)

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team in a contract capacity. In this role, you will have the chance to build relationships with our engineering leaders and contribute to the hyper-growth of Klaviyo, influencing our product and culture tremendously through the exceptional engineers you bring into the company!

You'll own your recruiting numbers (sourcing, screening, and hiring) and draw insights from analytics to make our hiring process smarter and more efficient.

s.h: How You Will Make a Difference
s.t:
· Build pipelines of candidates: Our engineering org is consistently hiring across disciplines (backend, frontend, infrastructure, ML, and beyond), so a key aspect of this role is working with engineering hiring managers to develop strategies to find qualified, diverse technical candidates. You'll build talent networks through proactive market research, targeted outreach, and strong candidate experience.

· Own the process: From sourcing passive engineering talent to closing offers, you will be responsible for providing all candidates with an exceptional experience and ensuring Klaviyo is engaging with and hiring the exceptional engineers who will help scale our product and platform.

· Build relationships: Your empathy and customer-first approach will forge lasting relationships with both candidates and engineering hiring managers, and you'll act as a trusted advisor on technical hiring strategy.

· Be an ambassador: Whether through Klaviyo's engineering blog, technical recruiting events, or LinkedIn/GitHub outreach, you are an ambassador for Klaviyo's engineering culture and, in most cases, the first impression a candidate will have of the company. You'll take a balanced approach that makes a candidate feel like an individual while keeping in mind Klaviyo's business and technical objectives.

· AI fluency and adoption: Leverage AI tools and automation to streamline recruiting workflows, reduce administrative burden, and increase capacity to focus on high-impact technical hiring work.

· 7+ years of recruiting experience, with significant experience hiring within software engineering, infrastructure, or related technical disciplines

· Strong sourcing expertise and passion for identifying passive technical talent, with the ability to assess technical resumes and career trajectories

· Working knowledge of engineering roles, tech stacks, and terminology sufficient to credibly engage engineers and hiring managers on scope and leveling

· Ability to influence and advise senior technical stakeholders on role scoping, leveling, and engineering talent market dynamics

· Data-driven approach to managing pipelines and measuring recruiting performance

· Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments

· High level of ownership, accountability, and sound judgment

· Ability to recognize the balance between business/engineering needs and providing a stellar candidate experience
